read.thesis: Nike's Q3 is a deliberate reset: revenue flat reported, Greater China down 10% with Q4 guided down about 20%, and gross margin pressure from 300bp tariffs, with margin inflection only from Q2 FY27.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue down 2%-4%
triggers.quote: We expect revenues in Q4 to be down 2% to 4%, with modest growth in North America

triggers.label: Gross margin hit 300bp from tariffs
triggers.quote: Gross margins declined 130 basis points to 40.2% on a reported basis, primarily due to 300 basis points associated with higher tariffs in North America.

triggers.label: Greater China inventory down mid teens
triggers.quote: Inventory was down mid teens versus the prior year, with units down more than 20%, and partner inventory also declined double digits.

triggers.label: $230M severance to cut fixed supply chain cost
triggers.quote: Our specific actions in the Supply Chain will lower costs, streamline operations, and reduce capacity in our distribution network.

triggers.label: EMEA Sportswear down double digits
triggers.quote: Sportswear was down double digits, and sell-through has not tracked with sell-in expectations.

guidance.value: down approximately 25 to 75 basis points, including 250bp tariff impact

red_flags.label: Greater China sell-in cut, Q4 down ~20%
red_flags.quote: Greater China to be down approximately 20% in the fourth quarter, reflecting reduced sell-in that we highlighted last quarter

red_flags.label: Digital too promotional, markdowns elevated
red_flags.quote: digital is still too promotional. Markdowns across the marketplace remain elevated.

red_flags.label: EMEA inventory to end Q4 elevated
red_flags.quote: we anticipate ending the fourth quarter with elevated inventory.

evasions.topic: Guidance shaping (quarterly split of calendar-year guide)
evasions.quote: without getting into specifics of November versus December
what I would say, Simeon, is that North America is the geography where we saw the most improvement
